natural_language_questions: What was the on-time delivery rate by carrier in FY2026-Q3?

system_instruction:
system_instruction: You are a logistics operations analyst. Report shipment dates in UTC and name carriers
  exactly. Logistics and warehouse managers.
glossaries:
- glossary:
  - term: punctuality
  - description: Use shipments.on_time_delivery_rate.
  - synonyms: []
- glossary:
  - term: fulfillment center
  - description: Use warehouses.warehouse_name.
  - synonyms: []
- glossary:
  - term: Active Customer
  - description: A non-test customer with at least one non-deleted order in the period. (derived from
      catalog:active_customer; field orders.active_customer_count)
  - synonyms:
    - active customers
    - buying customers
- glossary:
  - term: Carrier
  - description: Freight carrier that moved the shipment. "Northstar Freight" and "North Star Freight
      LLC" are different companies. (derived from catalog:carrier; field carriers.carrier_name)
  - synonyms:
    - shipping carrier
    - freight carrier
- glossary:
  - term: Customer
  - description: A business that buys from Harborline, identified by its legal company name. (derived
      from catalog:customer; field customers.company_name)
  - synonyms:
    - customer name
    - account
- glossary:
  - term: Customer Segment
  - description: Enterprise, Mid-Market or SMB, based on annual spend band. (derived from catalog:customer_segment;
      field customers.segment)
  - synonyms:
    - segment
- glossary:
  - term: Fiscal Quarter
  - description: A three-month period of the Harborline fiscal year, which starts February 1. "Last quarter"
      means the last completed fiscal quarter. (derived from catalog:fiscal_quarter; field shipped_fiscal.fiscal_quarter_label)
  - synonyms:
    - quarter
    - fiscal qtr
- glossary:
  - term: Fiscal Year
  - description: February 1 to January 31, named by the calendar year in which it ends (FY2026 = Feb 2025
      to Jan 2026). (derived from catalog:fiscal_year; field shipped_fiscal.fiscal_year)
  - synonyms:
    - fy
- glossary:
  - term: Gross Revenue
  - description: Sum of order line amounts before discounts and refunds. (derived from catalog:gross_revenue;
      field orders.gross_revenue)
  - synonyms:
    - gross sales
    - bookings
- glossary:
  - term: Net Revenue
  - description: Gross order revenue minus discounts minus refunds, attributed to the order date. This
      is the company's default meaning of "revenue" and "sales". (derived from catalog:net_revenue; field
      orders.net_revenue)
  - synonyms:
    - revenue
    - sales
    - net sales
    - turnover
- glossary:
  - term: On-Time Delivery
  - description: Share of delivered shipments delivered on or before the promised date. (derived from
      catalog:on_time_delivery; field shipments.on_time_delivery_rate)
  - synonyms:
    - on-time rate
    - otd
    - on time delivery rate
- glossary:
  - term: Order Count
  - description: Number of orders, excluding test accounts and soft-deleted orders. (derived from catalog:order_count;
      field orders.order_count)
  - synonyms:
    - orders
    - number of orders
    - order volume
- glossary:
  - term: Region
  - description: Sales region of the customer. "Pacific NW" is a legacy spelling of "Pacific Northwest".
      (derived from catalog:region; field regions.region_name)
  - synonyms:
    - sales region
    - territory
- glossary:
  - term: Shipment Count
  - description: Number of shipments that left a Harborline warehouse. (derived from catalog:shipment_count;
      field shipments.shipment_count)
  - synonyms:
    - shipments
    - number of shipments
- glossary:
  - term: Shipment Status
  - description: Normalized carrier status. "Shipped" and "Shipped - Partial" are different statuses.
      (derived from catalog:shipment_status; field shipments.status)
  - synonyms:
    - status
- glossary:
  - term: Transit Time
  - description: Days between a shipment leaving the warehouse and its delivery, measured in UTC. (derived
      from catalog:transit_time; field shipments.avg_transit_days)
  - synonyms:
    - transit days
    - average transit time
    - delivery time
- glossary:
  - term: Warehouse
  - description: Harborline distribution center that fulfilled the order. (derived from catalog:warehouse;
      field warehouses.warehouse_name)
  - synonyms:
    - distribution center
    - dc
additional_descriptions:
- text: '[revenue-default] "Revenue" means net revenue unless the user explicitly says gross.'
- text: '[fiscal-quarter] "Last quarter" means the last completed fiscal quarter; the fiscal year starts
    February 1.'
- text: '[fiscal-year] "Last year" means the last completed fiscal year (FY2026 = Feb 2025 to Jan 2026).'
- text: '[last-month] "Last month" means the last completed calendar month.'
- text: '[exclude-test-accounts] Never include test accounts or soft-deleted orders, even when asked for
    all data.'
- text: '[state-the-period] Always state the time period an answer covers.'
- text: '[shipped-is-exact] A "Shipped" filter means the normalized status Shipped only, never "Shipped
    - Partial".'
- text: '[carriers-distinct] Northstar Freight and North Star Freight LLC are different carriers; never
    merge them.'
- text: '[transit-time] "Transit time" means average transit days.'
- text: '[no-customer-pii] Guardrail: Never return customer email, phone, date of birth, billing address
    or contact name.'
- text: '[derived] carriers.carrier_name: Carrier legal name. ''Northstar Freight'' and ''North Star Freight
    LLC'' are different carriers. Never merge them.'
- text: '[derived] customers.company_name: Legal name of the customer company.'
- text: '[derived] customers.segment: Enterprise, Mid-Market or SMB.'
- text: '[derived] orders.active_customer_count: Distinct customers with at least one order in the period.'
- text: '[derived] orders.gross_revenue: Sum of order line amounts before discounts and refunds.'
- text: '[derived] orders.net_revenue: Gross revenue minus discounts minus refunds, attributed to the
    order date (late refunds reduce the period of the original order).'
- text: '[derived] orders.order_count: Number of orders (excluding test accounts and soft-deleted orders).'
- text: '[derived] regions.region_name: Sales region of the customer. The legacy value ''Pacific NW''
    is normalized to ''Pacific Northwest''.'
- text: '[derived] shipments.avg_transit_days: Average days between leaving the warehouse and delivery
    (UTC), for delivered shipments.'
- text: '[derived] shipments.on_time_delivery_rate: Share of delivered shipments delivered on or before
    the promised date.'
- text: '[derived] shipments.shipment_count: Number of shipments.'
- text: '[derived] shipments.status: Normalized carrier status. Raw spellings such as ''shipped'' and
    ''SHIPPED '' are normalized to ''Shipped''. ''Shipped - Partial'' is a different status.'
- text: '[derived] shipped_fiscal.fiscal_quarter_label: Fiscal quarter such as FY2026-Q3.'
- text: '[derived] shipped_fiscal.fiscal_year: Fiscal year, named by the calendar year in which it ends.'
- text: '[derived] warehouses.warehouse_name: Distribution center name.'
